description: List a domain the user owns for sale. The first call returns a DNS TXT record that proves ownership; once it's added, calling again with the same domain and email activates the listing. asking_price is shown to buyers; floor_price, the lowest offer accepted automatically, never is. Sales close through Escrow.com.

listing_key.description: Needed to change an active listing
